descriptionGame:
After Ella has introduced herself once at the beginning, the actual study starts, and your child will always see Ella and three other pictures. Each time, Ella asks your child to choose one of the pictures.

If you are using a tablet, please let your child tap the picture they want to choose themselves. If you are using a PC, please let your child point at the screen, and you click the picture your child pointed at. A picture is selected when a blue frame appears.

If necessary, you can play the audio again by clicking the speaker icon. As soon as your child has decided on a picture, click "CONTINUE" to go on.
instructionsGame:
Is your child unsure or asking you for help? Feel free to encourage them with phrases like "Just choose what you think" or "I'm not sure either, what do you think?", and please don't give the answer.
If your child becomes restless or bored, you can take a short break at any time. Take as much time as you like!
If you want to stop the study, simply close the window. Your data will then not be saved this time.
headingfullscreen:
We are now starting the recording.

If a pop-up window asking for permission to use the camera appears again, please click 'Allow' again.

Please click 'CONTINUE' now to activate full-screen mode.
noiseQuestion:
Did you just hear a short tinkling sound?

Yes? Great! Feel free to adjust the volume so that your child can hear the tinkling well.

No? Please click the speaker icon to test your sound again.

Now we can finally begin! Please click 'CONTINUE' now to start the game.
